title: The politics of postmortem privacy
abstract: arXiv:2608.16905v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While the existence of postmortem privacy is increasingly acknowledged (such as the protection of the presence of deceased within digital spaces), far less attention has been paid to its internal instability: its scope (the extent of its application), justificatory foundations (why do we protect the deceased in the first place), and uneven articulation across jurisdictions (for example, some jurisdictions may tolerate or endorse practices that may be contestable in a different jurisdiction). This piece unearths the internal diversity of the concept by illuminating specific points of tension and conflict that the notion of postmortem privacy evokes. These points of tension are collectively refer to as the politics of postmortem privacy. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16905v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：尽管死后隐私的存在日益得到认可（例如保护逝者在数字空间中的存在），但其内部不稳定性却鲜少受到关注：其范围（适用的程度）、正当性基础（我们为何首先保护逝者）以及在不同司法管辖区的不均匀表述（例如，某些司法管辖区可能容忍或认可在另一司法管辖区可能引起争议的做法）。本文通过揭示死后隐私概念引发的具体紧张和冲突点，挖掘了这一概念的内部多样性。这些紧张点统称为死后隐私的政治。为此，本文整理了现有法律学术贡献，将其与更广泛的文化、社会、历史和政治观察进行对话，以阐明死后隐私的政治。
tldr: 本文揭示了死后隐私概念内部的多样性及其在范围、正当性和司法实践中的紧张点，统称为“死后隐私的政治”。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the internal diversity of postmortem privacy and its points of tension in scope, justification, and jurisdictional practice, collectively termed the "politics of postmortem privacy."
